# zurds

zurds reads the files R writes with
[`saveRDS()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/readRDS.html),
[`save()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/save.html) and
[`serialize()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/serialize.html), and lazy-load
databases, without handing them to R’s deserializer. It can tell you
what a file holds, pull out one object, check whether a file is safe to
load, and read data-only files with a reader that cannot run code.

[`readRDS()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/readRDS.html) and
[`load()`](https://rdrr.io/r/base/load.html) are all or nothing: to
learn what a 2 GB `.rda` contains, or whether a model file from a
colleague carries closures and environments, you have to load all of it,
and loading can run code (CVE-2024-27322). zurds walks the file instead,
building nothing it was not asked for.

## Installation

Install the released version from CRAN:

``` r

install.packages("zurds")
```

Or the development version from GitHub:

``` r

# install.packages("pak")
pak::pak("pedrobtz/zurds")
```

## What is in a file

``` r

library(zurds)
f <- system.file("extdata", "objects.rda", package = "zurds")

rds_toc(f)
#>        name    type      class length     dim size offset risky
#> 1      cars    list data.frame     11 10 x 11 1396     48 FALSE
#> 2   species integer     factor      3    <NA>  133   1467 FALSE
#> 3      grid  double       <NA>      6   2 x 3   95   1620 FALSE
#> 4 summarise closure       <NA>      1    <NA>  132   1740  TRUE
```

[`rds_str()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_str.md)
summarises any file the way [`str()`](https://rdrr.io/r/utils/str.html)
does, and
[`rds_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_info.md)
reads its header.

## Is it safe to load?

``` r

rds_scan(system.file("extdata", "promise.rds", package = "zurds"))
#>    path finding detail severity
#> 1 [[2]] promise   <NA> executes
```

A promise, a closure or bytecode can run code; an environment, a
namespace or an external pointer reaches outside the file; ALTREP and S4
classes need their packages.
[`rds_is_safe()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_scan.md)
is `TRUE` when the scan finds nothing, and
[`rds_deps()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_deps.md)
lists the packages a file would need.

## Reading data safely

``` r

f <- system.file("extdata", "iris.rds", package = "zurds")
identical(rds_read_data(f), readRDS(f))
#> [1] TRUE
```

[`rds_read_data()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_read_data.md)
builds only vectors, lists and their attributes, and refuses everything
else.
[`rds_extract()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_extract.md)
reads one object, element or column without building the rest, and
[`rds_lazyload_toc()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_lazyload_toc.md)
and
[`rds_lazyload_extract()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_lazyload_extract.md)
do the same for lazy-load databases.

See
[`vignette("safe-reading", package = "zurds")`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/articles/safe-reading.md)
for what the safety guarantee covers and what it does not.

# Package index

## Look inside a file

Without building anything it holds.

- [`rds_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_info.md)
  : Header of an R serialization file
- [`rds_str()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_str.md) :
  Structure of an R serialization file
- [`rds_toc()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_toc.md) :
  Table of contents of an .rda file

## Is it safe?

- [`rds_scan()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_scan.md)
  [`rds_is_safe()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_scan.md)
  : Scan an R serialization file for code and references
- [`rds_deps()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_deps.md)
  : Packages a file needs

## Read data

With a reader that builds only data and never runs code.

- [`rds_read_data()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_read_data.md)
  : Read a data-only R serialization file safely
- [`rds_extract()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_extract.md)
  : Extract one object or element from an R serialization file

## Lazy-load databases

- [`rds_lazyload_toc()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_lazyload_toc.md)
  : Table of contents of a lazy-load database
- [`rds_lazyload_extract()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/rds_lazyload_extract.md)
  : Extract one object from a lazy-load database

## The package

- [`zurds_info()`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds_info.md)
  : Build information
- [`zurds-conditions`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds-conditions.md)
  : Conditions raised by zurds
- [`zurds`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds-package.md)
  [`zurds-package`](https://pedrobtz.github.io/zurds/reference/zurds-package.md)
  : zurds: Inspect and Safely Read R Serialization Files
